scripts.build: npm run build-renderer && npm run build-main
scripts.build:ci: npm run codegen:napi && tsc && npm run build-renderer:ci
scripts.build:quick: npm run build-renderer && npm run build-main:quick
scripts.build-renderer: npm run check-web-deps && cross-env-shell _ENTE_IS_DESKTOP=1 "cd ../web && npm run build:photos && cd ../desktop && shx rm -rf out && shx cp -r ../web/apps/photos/out out"
scripts.build-renderer:ci: cross-env-shell _ENTE_IS_DESKTOP=1 "cd ../web && npm ci && npm run build:photos && cd ../desktop && shx rm -rf out && shx cp -r ../web/apps/photos/out out"
scripts.dev: node scripts/postinstall.mjs --if-needed && node scripts/napi.js build && concurrently --kill-others --success first --names 'main,rndr' "npm run dev-main" "npm run dev-renderer"
scripts.dev-renderer: npm run check-web-deps && cross-env-shell _ENTE_IS_DESKTOP=1 "cd ../web && npm exec --workspace photos -- next dev --webpack -p 3008"
